messages:
samir: Heads-up — ACME Health just pushed back on the audit bundle proposal. They want per-tenant signed bundles (HMAC + timestamped manifest), a verification script they can run, and explicit contract language for acceptance tests. They want answers by EOD. Who owns schema + delivery SLA?

elaine: Thanks Samir. For FedRAMP/SOC2-like asks we should include: event_type, event_time (iso8601), tenant_id, request_id, actor_identity (rbac role + principal id), resource, action, outcome, and an integrity section: {signature_alg, signature_value, signing_key_id, manifest_hash}. Also need nonce/sequence for ordering.

josh: I can spin up an export endpoint for signed bundles (bundle_export/v1) and a minimal manifest format. Proposal: bundles are NDJSON gzipped, manifest.json contains file list + sha256 and HMAC-SHA256 over manifest using a per-customer signing key. We'll expose a POST /v1/tenants/:id/bundles?from=...&to=... and return a presigned URL for download.

maria.legal: Contract notes: acceptance should be explicit — "Customer will provide a validation script which we must pass against a sample bundle in the staging environment." We should avoid open-ended SLAs. Suggest: acceptance test = verifies schema version, required fields present, HMAC verifies with provided public key (or KMS-wrapped verification key), and bundle integrity matches SHA256. If failure, remediation window = 5 business days.

devops-bot: deploy 2409992500: feature/tenant-bundles (wip) pushed to staging.

samir: @josh @elaine two quick concerns: 1) RBAC — we can't let every support engineer trigger full-tenant exports. Need an RBAC permission (audit:export:full) and an audit record of the export itself. 2) KMS — customers want BYOK for signing keys; how do we expose verification without giving them the raw key?

elaine: Agree on RBAC. We should treat bundle export as a high-sensitivity operation: require 2-step approval for production exports (request -> approver), log both request and approval as separate audit events, and redact sensitive PII in-export by default unless customer contract explicitly permits full export. For BYOK, we can offer two modes: a) Redwood-owned key: we sign and store HMAC key in our KMS under a customer-wrapped CMK; we provide verification material (public key or verification endpoint). b) Customer-supplied key: customer uploads a verification key (public) and we sign with a derived key inside their KMS (if private) or provide an HMAC that customer can validate externally.

josh: Implementation plan (rough):
- schema bump audit_event v2 with integrity metadata (1 day)
- add bundle_export/v1 endpoint and staging flow (3 days)
- approval workflow + RBAC changes (2 days)
- KMS integration: Redwood-KMS BYOK path + verification API (5 days)
Total: ~11 working days for staging MVP. Can scope down to 4 days if we deliver signed sample + verification script only.

maria.legal: For SLA language: suggest we offer two tiers: Standard (sample bundles monthly + on-demand export w/ 5bd remediation window) and Enterprise (SLA-backed weekly bundles, 99.9% availability for export API, defined penalty for missed delivery). Require customers to run their validation script within 10 business days of receiving sample; acceptance date locks SLA.

samir: Risks: vuln/triage surface if signing key is compromised. Add KMS key-rotation docs and monitoring alerts for unusual export patterns (high volume, odd time windows). Also need an internal playbook in incidents/ for responding to suspected bundle tampering — who rotates keys, who engages legal, who notifies customer.

elaine: I'll draft an acceptance-test checklist and example verification script (node + bash) that customers can run. Will include example manifest and failure modes. Also will add retention/chain-of-custody notes for legal.

josh: I'll take owner for the API work and a PR for schema changes. Creating a tracking epic and will link to this thread.

samir: Thanks. Action items: @josh create epic + staging sample by tomorrow; @elaine draft verification script + playbook; @maria.legal draft contract language options. I'll coordinate with sales for ACME response.

maria.legal: Noted. I'll propose contract text today and flag required indemnity/notification clauses.

samir: Perfect. Marking this thread resolved for now — follow-ups in the epic. :white_check_mark:
